mapper.sql: id,name,person_type type,person_code code,id_number,(SELECT role_key FROM users WHERE users.person_id=people.id LIMIT 1) role,college,class_name,phone,NULL face_status,status,department,position,NULL host,company,CAST(graduation_year AS CHAR) graduation_year,major,NULL gate
mapper.select: SELECT FROM users WHERE BINARY username=BINARY #{name} LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM users ORDER BY created_at,id
SELECT FROM people ORDER BY created_at,id
SELECT role_key roleKey,label FROM roles ORDER BY role_key

SELECT r.role_key roleKey,MIN(p.id) personId,COALESCE(MIN(p.name),r.label) name,r.title,r.role_key role,MIN(p.person_type) type,r.avatar_url avatar,MIN(p.status) status FROM roles r LEFT JOIN users u ON u.role_key=r.role_key AND u.status='正常' LEFT JOIN people p ON p.id=u.person_id GROUP BY r.role_key,r.label,r.title,r.avatar_url ORDER BY r.role_key

SELECT id token,user_id userId,(SELECT role_key FROM users WHERE users.id=auth_tokens.user_id) role,DATE_FORMAT(issued_at,'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.000Z') createdAt,DATE_FORMAT(expires_at,'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.000Z') expiresAt FROM auth_tokens WHERE token_type='SESSION' AND token_digest=#{token} AND consumed_at IS NULL
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM auth_tokens WHERE token_type='SESSION' AND token_digest=#{token}
DELETE FROM auth_tokens WHERE token_type='SESSION' AND user_id=#{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET password_hash=#{hash} WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT purpose,subject phone,user_id userId,token_digest digest,CAST(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(issued_at)*1000 AS SIGNED) sentAt,CAST(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(expires_at)*1000 AS SIGNED) expiresAt,attempts FROM auth_tokens WHERE token_type='VERIFY_CODE' AND purpose=#{purpose} AND subject=#{phone} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO auth_tokens(id,token_type,token_digest,user_id,subject,purpose,issued_at,expires_at,attempts) VALUES(SHA2(CONCAT('VERIFY_CODE:',#{purpose},':',#{phone}),256),'VERIFY_CODE',#{digest},#{userId},#{phone},#{purpose},FROM_UNIXTIME(#{sentAt}/1000),FROM_UNIXTIME(#{expiresAt}/1000),0) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE user_id=VALUES(user_id),token_digest=VALUES(token_digest),issued_at=VALUES(issued_at),expires_at=VALUES(expires_at),attempts=0,consumed_at=NULL
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM auth_tokens WHERE token_type='VERIFY_CODE' AND purpose=#{purpose} AND subject=#{phone}
mapper.update: UPDATE auth_tokens SET attempts=attempts+1 WHERE token_type='VERIFY_CODE' AND purpose=#{purpose} AND subject=#{phone}
mapper.select: SELECT f.id,f.person_id personId,p.name personName,f.status,f.file_name fileName,f.image_url imageUrl,f.slot_key slot,f.label,DATE_FORMAT(f.updated_at,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') updatedAt FROM faces f JOIN people p ON p.id=f.person_id ORDER BY f.updated_at DESC,f.id
SELECT v.id,v.owner_id ownerId,p.name ownerName,v.plate_no plateNo,v.status,DATE_FORMAT(v.last_access_at,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') lastAccess FROM vehicles v JOIN people p ON p.id=v.owner_id ORDER BY v.id
SELECT id,title,content,target_role targetRole,read_flag `read`,DATE_FORMAT(created_at,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') createdAt FROM messages ORDER BY created_at DESC,id
SELECT id,DATE_FORMAT(occurred_at,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') time,actor_name_snapshot actor,actor_role_snapshot role,action,target,result FROM audit_logs ORDER BY occurred_at DESC,id

SELECT FROM people BINARY person_type=BINARY #{type}AND (INSTR(BINARY name,BINARY #{keyword})>0 OR INSTR(BINARY person_code,BINARY #{keyword})>0 OR INSTR(BINARY phone,BINARY #{keyword})>0 OR INSTR(BINARY college,BINARY #{keyword})>0 OR INSTR(BINARY department,BINARY #{keyword})>0) ORDER BY created_at,id
SELECT FROM users WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM people WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
